en.title: UN Experts Urge Europe to Reject Coercive Psychiatry in Disability Rights Push
en.summary: UN disability organisations and UN experts have urged the Council of Europe to reject a draft mental health protocol that would legitimize coercion and forced treatment. Meanwhile, Cloud of Goods called for destination readiness ahead of the ADA anniversary, Yellow Teng‑hui was named a public welfare ambassador promoting inclusion, and ISTELive 26 focused on new digital accessibility guidelines for K‑12. Additional updates include a Phoenix Sky Harbor accessibility guide and a social‑media report of a worker being instructed to stop requesting workplace accommodations.

zh-TW.title: 聯合國專家呼籲歐洲拒絕強制精神治療 推動殘障權利
zh-TW.summary: 聯合國殘障組織與專家呼籲歐洲理事會拒絕將精神科強制與強制治療合法化的草案附加議定書。同時，Cloud of Goods 呼籲各目的地在ADA紀念日前做好準備，黃鐙輝獲委任為公益大使推動共融，ISTELive 26 會議聚焦新數位無障礙指南。鳳凰天港機場發布無障礙服務指南，此外社群媒體上有推文指出殘障員工被要求停止申請工作場所便利措施。
